text: dsh-copy-session-id 是面向 DSH Web 的小型会话辅助插件，在会话标题旁注册一个可点击的会话 ID 控件。它显示当前会话 ID，长 ID 在界面中截断但复制时保留完整值；点击后优先使用浏览器 Clipboard API，并在失败时尝试传统复制方式，成功后短暂显示反馈。中英文界面均提供提示文本，适合需要快速查看或粘贴会话标识的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-copy-session-id adds a clickable session ID control beside the title in DSH Web. It displays the ID and copies its full value on click, using the browser clipboard with a legacy fallback. Long IDs are visually truncated, and brief feedback confirms copying. Chinese and English labels included.

dsh-copy-session-id 的功能「显示会话 ID」：在会话标题操作区显示当前会话 ID 控件，长值只在视觉上截断。会话 ID 由框架提供。
dsh-copy-session-id 的功能「一键复制」：点击会话 ID 控件时复制完整 ID；优先调用 Clipboard API，失败后尝试 document.execCommand。
dsh-copy-session-id 的功能「复制状态提示」：复制成功后短暂显示已复制状态，约 1.5 秒后恢复普通提示。

dsh-copy-session-id README · dsh-copy-session-id：[中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web plugin that displays the current session ID in the session header and copies the complete value to the clipboard on click.

dsh-copy-session-id README · Behavior：- Displays a compact monospace session-ID control beside the title, truncating long values visually.
- Copies the complete ID with one click and shows a short confirmation state.
- Localizes its tooltip for Chinese and English interfaces.

dsh-copy-session-id README · Run from the repository root.：dsh plugin --profile web add ".\dsh-copy-session-id"
```

The package bundle patch inserts `copy-session-id`, while `dsh.client` exposes `lib/client.js` through the DSH Web boot graph. Restart `dsh web` after installation.

dsh-copy-session-id README · Implementation：The client registers in the `conversation.session.header.actions` session slot. It receives the stable `sessionId` from the framework, copies with `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, and falls back to `document.execCommand('copy')` when necessary. The host half intentionally has an empty `apply` function so Loader keeps the client module active.
